Verified notes

- TOML: day backends 15–22; tool-night 30–37. omen-dense-27b: 17, 32; omen-perception: 22, 37. Status changes: am4-vllm 18 live → 33 absent; am4-tool-4070ti 19 absent → 34 live; am4-tool-5070 20 absent → 35 live.
- sizing_map.py: collect_configurations 469–510 reads all configurations (478–489); live rows add context_tokens/parallel_slots/max_tokens (486–487), absent rows status only (485).
- Invariants 664–760 use the active configuration only; expected live/absent from configuration rows (673–683); live checks 685–709, absent routability 711–726, families 728–760. Without --live, active configuration is unprobed (506), so active-config checks are skipped (665). AM4 alias mapping 355, 702, 720. No day-vs-tool-night diff; no comparison of configuration TOML numbers to backends-linux.toml.

Report

This audit compares configuration.day and configuration.tool-night in host/lab-configurations.toml with tools/ops/sizing_map.py. The tool reads the named configurations from the TOML and records the declared sizing parameters: for live backends, status, context_tokens, parallel_slots, and max_tokens; for absent backends, status only. Its whole-lab invariants use only the active configuration to build expected live/absent sets and check live serving, absent routability, and family resolution; for AM4, am4-vllm is mapped to the am4-dense-27b facade alias. It does not directly diff day against tool-night, and it does not compare the TOML’s declared numbers to backends-linux.toml.

Declared values: omen-dense-27b is live in both configurations with context_tokens 65536, parallel_slots 2, and max_tokens 16384. omen-perception is live in both with parallel_slots 2; context_tokens and max_tokens are not declared in either configuration.

When the lab moves from day to tool-night, three backends change status: am4-vllm changes from live to absent, while am4-tool-4070ti and am4-tool-5070 change from absent to live. omen-vllm, omen-dense-27b, fx99-vllm, and omen-perception remain live. Under day, the active-configuration invariants would expect am4-vllm live and the two AM4 tool seats absent; under tool-night, they would expect the two AM4 tool seats live and am4-vllm absent.
